prose: Healthleap, a startup that reads patient records to find people at risk of undiagnosed illnesses, raised $38 million: a $30 million Series A and an $8 million seed round, TechCrunch reports.
The excerpt describes the software as screening to flag patients who may need a closer look. Investors and clinical results are not in the excerpt.
highlights: AI reads records to flag patients at risk of undiagnosed illness
Investors and validation not covered in the excerpt
